name: Laboratory
definition: A facility equipped and competent to conduct scientific experiments, observations, tests, investigations, and/or to manufacture chemicals or medical products.

name: Coordinating Center
definition: A facility that is responsible for receiving, editing, processing, analyzing, and storing data generated in a study and that, in addition, has responsibility for coordination of activities required for execution of the study.

name: Research Center
definition: A facility established for research, often designed to promote interactions between faculty, scholars, students, and industry.

name: Diagnostics or Therapeutics Unit
definition: A department that specializes on the pathogenesis, diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of disease.
